description:
Simulate an emergency evacuation drill. 

1. Register and Check In three visitors:
   - Name: Alice Safety | Company: OSHA Inc
   - Name: Bruce Hazard | Company: Risk Corp
   - Name: Charlie Drill | Company: Safety First

2. Immediately Check Out visitor 'Charlie Drill' (simulating he left the building).

3. Generate an evacuation list showing ONLY people currently inside the building (Checked In status).

4. Export this filtered list to a CSV file named 'evacuation_list.csv' in the 'Documents' folder ('/home/ga/Documents/evacuation_list.csv'). 

The final file MUST contain Alice and Bruce, but MUST NOT contain Charlie.
